server-invoke.card.title: {caller} asks to call "{agent}"
server-invoke.card.titleWaiting: {caller} asks to call "{agent}" ({n, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} waiting)
server-invoke.card.titleWaitingFrom: {caller} asks to call "{agent}" ({n, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} waiting, from {ais, plural, one {# AI} other {# AIs}})
server-invoke.error.notWaiting: This call is not waiting on any call request
server-invoke.error.requestDecided: This call request was already decided ({label})
server-invoke.error.requestExpired: This call request has expired (nobody handled it for seven days): the caller has to call again
server-invoke.refused.agent_unknown: No such agent, or it is not open to you
server-invoke.refused.not_listed: This agent is open only to chosen people, and you are not on the list
server-invoke.refused.not_recognised: I don't know you: the other side has not recognised you (has not added your identity card), or your token is not valid
server-invoke.refused.rejected_recently: The owner just refused your call to this agent: do not retry
server-invoke.refused.too_many_requests: Too many call requests are waiting for the owner's approval: try again later
server-invoke.refused.too_many_waiting: You already have many calls waiting for the owner's approval: try again after the owner has dealt with them
server-invoke.settled.expired: The owner did not handle this call request within seven days; it has expired
server-invoke.stop.contactRemoved: The other side removed you from its contacts
server-invoke.stop.grantRevoked: The owner revoked your grant to call this agent
server-invoke.stop.issuerChanged: The other side no longer trusts the issuer that vouched for you
server-invoke.stop.notAdmitted: The owner took back your permission to call this agent
server-invoke.stop.reset: The other side reset its PIN; every outside permission was revoked
server-invoke.why.agentClosed: this agent no longer exists or is no longer open to others
server-invoke.why.contactRemoved: the caller is no longer in the contacts
server-invoke.why.expired: nobody handled it for seven days; it expired
server-invoke.why.issuerGone: the external issuer that vouched for this person is no longer used
server-invoke.why.needsApproval: it has to wait for the owner's approval
server-invoke.why.noLongerNeeded: no approval needed any more: they can call directly now (allowlist, chosen people or a grant)
server-invoke.why.notOpenToThem: this agent is no longer open to them
server-invoke.why.notRecognised: the caller is no longer recognised (not in the contacts, or the issuer of their identity is no longer used)
server-invoke.why.onceUsed: the one-time approval was already used
server-invoke.why.pinReset: the owner reset the PIN; every outside permission was revoked
